title: The fossil fuel comeback is here
hook_text: Data centers are draining the grid
hook_before: The US is building more fossil fuel infrastructure now than it has in a decade.
script:
Ten years. That is how long we waited for this massive fossil fuel comeback.
Electricity demand is climbing faster than it has in ten years.
At the same time, renewable energy growth is slowing down across the country.
More data centers, factories, and electric vehicles are plugging into the power grid.
The Verge published a new report detailing this surge in power demand.
Will your power bill go up because of this?
